description: Warm wall time and peak memory, GMaster vs NaMaster vs SHTns, HEALPix Nside 64-8192.

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, 96 GB (one card)
hardware.cpu: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9995WX, 96 cores / 192 threads

method: Each cell is one process inside a Docker container on an exclusive cpuset (GMaster: 8 cores + the GPU; NaMaster: 32 or all 96 physical cores). One untimed call, then warm calls; 'five warm runs' cells list all five, 'median' cells come from an earlier board that kept only the median. Transforms: alm2map and one map2alm pass (n_iter=0), lmax = 3 nside - 1, random inputs. End to end: ACT DR6 map and footprint mask, n_iter=3, NmtField + NmtWorkspace + coupled cell + decouple, linear bins of 30. GMaster uses XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false and its default routes.
